CustomField.description: Read-only display of the covered period range. Shows a single month when Period Start and Period End are the same, otherwise start and end joined by a tilde.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Period_Start__c), ISBLANK(Period_End__c) ), NULL, IF( Period_Start__c = Period_End__c, Period_Start__c, Period_Start__c & " ~ " & Period_End__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 지급이 커버하는 기간입니다. 자동 계산되며 수정할 수 없습니다.
CustomField.label: Period
